name: Orbit Fleet Agents (fictional)

one_liner.value: Orbit Fleet is a multi-agent platform: a team of AI agents that plan, write, schedule and publish your social media posts.

categories.quote: An agent platform for the whole marketing team

target_user.quote: Made for social media managers at agencies and enterprise marketing teams.

tasks.quote: The writer agent writes captions and the publisher agent schedules social posts a month ahead.

can_execute.quote: The publisher agent schedules and publishes posts to your channels automatically, around the clock.

multi_agent.quote: A planner agent, a writer agent and a publisher agent work together as one team.

notes: Invented site. /features redirects to /platform. The pricing page says to talk to sales: no price and no statement about a free plan. One sentence says a designer agent generates images and short videos: a task, but the site does not present itself as a video or creative tool. /drafts/ is disallowed for agent-scout and carries a price that must not appear.
